sidebar_desc.0:
### Create Project
Design applications from scratch. Set unique identities, versions, and metadata for the **Influent OS** ecosystem with guided steps.
sidebar_desc.1:
### Build Package
Package your work. Turn development folders into compressed `.iflapp` files ready for global distribution.
sidebar_desc.3:
### Settings
Tune the program engine. Control paths, language, appearance, and options stored in data/pm.data.
sidebar_desc.4:
### MoonFix Suite
Deep repair. Scan, detect, and fix inconsistencies in your packages. Ensure every asset and XML tag is correct.
sidebar_desc.5:
### About
Technical project details. GPL license, Qt framework, and the team behind **Package Maker**.

security_warning.risk_malware: • Malicious code execution: Third-party scripts could contain malware or ransomware.
security_warning.risk_access: • Unauthorized access: The project could read, modify, or delete system files without restrictions.
security_warning.risk_changes: • Uncontrolled changes: Critical system or project files could be altered without authorization.
security_warning.recommendation: Recommendation: Keep the Secure Sandbox enabled whenever you work with code from unverified sources, downloaded projects from the internet, or when you do not fully control the origin of every dependency.

tui.help_body:
1. Create Project
     Create a new project structure from scratch. You will enter:
     - Company/Publisher: Name of the organization
     - Internal ID (Slug): Unique identifier (e.g. my-app-tool)
     - Visible Name: Name users will see
     - Initial Version: Version number (e.g. 1.0.0)
     - Author: GitHub username (required)
     - Platform: Windows (Knosthalij), Linux (Danenone) or Multiplatform
     - Sandbox: Protection to prevent the code from being harmful

  2. Build Package
     Compile an existing project into an executable package. You can:
     - Select a project from the list or enter the path manually
     - Choose the mode: Portable (all-in-one) or Lite (single file)
     - Specify the output folder

  3. Application Manager
     Manage your existing projects. For each project you can:
     - Compile the package
     - Repair with MoonFix (for project issues)
     - Open in the file explorer
     - View project details

  4. MoonFix — Repair
     Automatic repair tool for projects with problems.
     Available options:
     - Check for missing files
     - Update old configurations
     - Repair folder structure
     - Check dependencies

  5. Settings
     Adjust the global application settings:
     - Projects folder (where new projects are saved)
     - Interface language (the one with a translation in lang/)

  6. About
     Show system information and the application version.

  Navigation Commands:

  - In any numbered menu, press [0] to go back
  - Press [Enter] to confirm selections
  - You can use [Ctrl+C] at any time to cancel

  Execution Modes:

  GUI (Graphical Interface):
    python packagemaker.py

  TUI (Terminal):
    python packagemaker.py --tui

  Headless (no GUI or TUI):
    python packagemaker.py create /path/to/project --name MyApp --author user
    python packagemaker.py compile /path/to/project --output ./dist --headless

  Additional Resources:

  - Documentation: https://github.com/Influent-PackageMaker
  - Repository: https://github.com/JesusQuijada34/packagemaker
tui.help_intro:
Influent Package Maker is a package management system to create,
compile and distribute applications easily. This TUI version
is designed for environments without a graphical interface (SSH, CI, WSL without X).
